$Comment: Percent bonus to the carrier's movement speed, in whole percent points (20 is +20%). Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers. ziggfreed-common carries the total to the engine as one hidden effect whose HorizontalSpeedMultiplier is 1 plus this percent, held between -90 and MoveSpeedMax, so it multiplies with every other speed effect the player has (a slow, a haste). Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
